# What is your docker-compose.yml handing to the host?

> Paste your docker-compose.yml and find risky settings: privileged: true, docker.sock mounts, network_mode host, cap_add SYS_ADMIN, databases on 0.0.0.0, literal secrets, :latest images. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
